notes.t: From the venue's documents: open bar extension: dekort_eur_pp_hr: 8, twc_eur_pp_hr: 13
Capacity: 150 guests
60 overnight guests on the island as standard, extra glamping/camping options
Partying without sound restrictions inside the tower
Offered a 7.5% discount on the rental price
Catering said to be cheaper than Almanita; the shared menus are for a full 3-day package
Guests can get back to hotels late; a nearby campsite is an option
UNESCO World Heritage island fortress from 1845, exclusive use
Website check: Overnight guests: site says 'the island sleeps 50 guests' and aims for 60 in 2027; email says 60. Prices page: EUR 8,500 per night 'including 50 beds' vs email 'for 60 people'.
Website check: Region Gelderland is not on the site; it comes from OpenStreetMap (Vuren, West Betuwe, Gelderland). Kept as recorded.
Website check: Record contact is the Villa Almanita team (same operator per the email); not checked against the site's contact page.
Website check: OpenStreetMap names the point at Waaldijk 29 'Fort Vurig' (hotel); coordinates taken from it.
Two caterer packages were sent: De Kort (one-day wedding) and The Welcome Collective (3-day Mon-Wed)
De Kort wedding package €225 pp (0-50 guests), €215 (51-60), €205 (61-80); no rate shown above 80 guests
De Kort package: 1 h welcome drinks, 2 h cocktail drinks, cava, 3 appetizers, 2.5 h dinner drinks, 3-course plated dinner, 2 h open bar; staff, setup and transport included
De Kort table styling (cutlery, glassware, linen, candles, vases) €17.75 pp, not in the package
De Kort extra open bar hours €8 pp per hour; cocktails €10.50; cava/prosecco €3.75 a glass
De Kort midnight snack €8.25 pp
De Kort pre/post-wedding meals: breakfast €18.50-19.50, lunch €11.50-22, BBQ €32.50-36.50, buffet €32.50-36.50, pizza party €22.50 pp
De Kort food trucks €2,450 for 50 guests (more guests may cost more); food stations €675-800 each for 50
De Kort kids €62.50 pp; vendor meals €65 pp
Welcome Collective 3-day arrangement (Mon-Wed) for 70-150 guests: Essential €285, Signature €450, Grand Luxe €620 pp, excl. VAT
Smaller groups pay more: 50-69 guests €305/€475/€650; 40-49 guests €325/€500/€680
Welcome Collective VAT: 9% on food and soft drinks, 21% on alcohol and everything else
3-day plan: Monday welcome dinner, Tuesday wedding day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, bonfire night), Wednesday brunch and BBQ dinner
Tuesday bonfire night: kitchen stays open, party runs as long as you want
Open bar included 2 h (Essential), 3 h (Signature), 4 h (Grand Luxe); extension €13 pp per hour
Extra tables, chairs, linen and tableware beyond the fort's standard setup from €28 pp excl. VAT
Live stations per party: oyster bar from €895, truffle €795, carving €750, cheese cart €650, cannoli €450, sabrage €395
Pay 5 working days before (or invoice after); final count 2 weeks ahead; cancellation 10% (>3 months), 35% (>1 month), 60% (>14 days), 100% (within 7 days)
Not included: flowers and decoration, VAT, transport beyond standard route; Thursday breakfast is by the fort's own restaurant before 10:00 departure
Caterer is booked through the fort's wedding planner
